summary: DOCS-004: Build documentation explains generated `Makefile.inc` and generator integration only briefly and contains spelling errors in names developers will copy (`Makefie.inc`, `usuall`). It also does not explain that `Makefile.drv` invokes `$(BUILD_BIN)/indigo_generator`, so a developer must build the generator before relying on automatic `.driver` regeneration. Clarify prerequisites and correct the names.

resolution.evidence: 20261023064302-ef56-fix-doc-findings-001-005/verification.md AC-004: Corrected makefile names and explained generated configuration, forced host/path refresh, automatic generator build and serialized regeneration against current make rules.
